comments.author: norskeld
comments.why: Carbon talk on compiler performance goals and challenges.
comments.text: Is lexing ever a bottleneck though? Even if you push for lexing and parsing 10M lines/second [1], I'd argue that semantic analysis and codegen (for AOT-compiled languages) will dominate the timings. That said, there's no reason not to squeeze every bit of performance out of it! [1]: In this talk about the Carbon language, Chandler Carruth shows and explains some goals/challenges regarding performance: [VIDEO]

comments.story: Flattening ASTs and other compiler data structures (2023)
comments.why: Chandler Carruth discusses flattened AST layout and its benefits.
comments.text: Chandler discusses it in this video though! [VIDEO] You get some traversals for free with this layout (preorder, reverse post order). Can search for subtrees with string searching algorithms or more complex things with regex.
